name: secret-guard
description: Keeps API keys, tokens and passwords out of the transcript, tool output, files, commits, PRs and issues.

mode.title: Secret guard: mode
mode.description: block refuses a risky call; warn lets it run and only declares it.

banner.title: Secret guard: banner
banner.description: How the guard shows itself above the prompt.

secretNames.title: Secret guard: secret variable names
secretNames.description: Regex (case-insensitive) for environment variable names whose values are secrets.

extraForbiddenPaths.title: Secret guard: extra forbidden paths
extraForbiddenPaths.description: Comma-separated globs added to the built-in list (e.g. config/prod.yaml,**/*.pem).

allowPaths.title: Secret guard: allowed paths
allowPaths.description: Comma-separated globs that are never treated as secret files.

redactOutput.title: Secret guard: redact output
redactOutput.description: Replace secret values and secret-shaped strings in anything stored in the transcript.

guardGit.title: Secret guard: git and GitHub
guardGit.description: Scan staged changes before git commit, outgoing commits before git push, and gh PR/issue/release/gist bodies.

loadEnvValues.title: Secret guard: know real values
loadEnvValues.description: Read the session's environment once (in memory only, never shown) so the guard can spot the real secret values.
